name: Love Death 2 ~Realtime Lovers~
source:
The main character is the grim reaper from another world called Fifth. He is in this world to get back a scythe. One day, he finds out that a man called Kuroda carries it. He tries to get it back by force, but he fails.... Also, he accidentally kills Mitsuru during the battle. He gets his body to conceal his death, and starts living as Mitsuru. He enjoys his life as a human being with his sister and childhood friends. One day, a new girl student comes to his school, and he gradually falls in love with her.... 

[From [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/7664]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
主人公是来自异世界‘Fifth’的死神，为取回一把镰刀而来到这个世界。一天，他发现镰刀在一个叫黑田的男人手中，试图强行夺回，却失败了……战斗中，他还意外杀死了满。为了隐瞒满的死亡，死神占据了他的身体，开始以满的身份生活。他与妹妹和青梅竹马们一同享受人类的日子。一天，学校来了一名转学生，他渐渐爱上了她……
